# GitHub Configuration

## Purpose

This directory contains GitHub-specific configuration files for the AutoForge AI repository, including issue templates, pull request templates, and workflow definitions.

## Contents

- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` — Templates for creating well-structured issues
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` — Template for pull request descriptions
- `workflows/` — CI/CD workflow definitions (to be implemented)

## Future Contents

- Issue templates for bug reports, feature requests, and tasks
- Pull request template with checklist and description format
- CI workflow for linting, type checking, and testing
- Release workflow for automated publishing
- Label management and automation rules
